title: Midnight Feature Reel
description: A woman in a long emerald green velvet dress stands in a dimly lit, decaying art studio at night, holding a film reel in her left hand while touching a large cracked painting of a stormy sea with two small boats. The floor is littered with scattered tickets and papers, a vintage gramophone sits nearby, and a single spotlight illuminates the scene from above.
